properties.rationale: Standing acknowledgement, re-stated because the rollup's id moves whenever the capability set does — it is now 62. Validation for this project is the trials programme: reflow2 used on real designs, which in the last two days meant an adopt pass over dynograph-foundation and a live two-session seam exercise that found four defects nobody had reviewed their way to, including two in reflow2 itself. It is not a validation-kind Verification per capability. Recording 62 near-identical validation nodes would turn the number green without anyone having checked anything, which is the dishonesty `dec:passing-is-verified` exists to prevent.
